exercises.prompt: Describe your favorite subject at school and explain why you enjoyed it.
Tell us about a teacher you had who was particularly good or particularly bad.
Some students prefer to study in groups, while others prefer to study alone. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering eliminating homework completely and assigning work only during class time. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your child's school is considering starting at 7:00 a.m. instead of 8:00 a.m. so students can finish earlier. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
